2607.25947.title: A Cost-Effective Multimodal LLM Reasoning Framework for Question Answering over Irregular Clinical Time Series
2607.25947.paper_summary: Question answering (QA) over irregular clinical time series (ICTS) plays a pivotal role in a wide range of healthcare applications. Although recent multimodal time-series large language models (LLMs) have shown considerable promise in general-purpose time-series QA, they remain poorly equipped to model the sparsity, asynchrony, and irregular sampling patterns of clinical observations. To fill this gap, we propose ClinPRISM, a cost-effective multimodal LLM reasoning framework for question answering over ICTS data. First, we devise an irregularity-aware multi-scale encoder to capture sparse clinical evidence at diverse temporal scales. Then, we propose a temporal evidence distiller to integrate representations across these scales and compress them into a small number of LLM-compatible tokens. Moreover, we introduce a progressive alignment strategy that sequentially aligns the irregular trajectories with the LLM's textual embedding space. To facilitate training, we construct 30,000 clinical time series paired with multi-scale descriptions, together with 41,000 instruction-tuning instances spanning 11 tasks. Using a 4-billion-parameter LLM backbone, ClinPRISM achieves state-of-the-art performance on the held-out evaluation benchmark while using only 16 time-series tokens and achieving an average inference latency of 0.15 seconds per question.
2607.25947.paper_summary_zh: 問題回答（QA）在不規則臨床時間序列（ICTS）中扮演著關鍵角色，廣泛應用於各種醫療保健應用中。儘管最近的多模態時間序列大型語言模型（LLMs）在通用時間序列QA中顯示出相當大的潛力，但它們在建模臨床觀察的稀疏性、非同步性和不規則取樣模式方面仍然能力不足。為填補這一空白，我們提出了ClinPRISM，一個具有成本效益的多模態LLM推理框架，用於對ICTS數據進行問題回答。首先，我們設計了一個不規則性感知的多尺度編碼器，以捕捉不同時間尺度上的稀疏臨床證據。然後，我們提出了一個時間證據提煉器，以整合這些尺度之間的表示並將其壓縮為少量的LLM兼容標記。此外，我們引入了一種漸進對齊策略，將不規則的軌跡與LLM的文本嵌入空間進行順序對齊。為了促進訓練，我們構建了30,000個臨床時間序列，並配有多尺度描述，還有41,000個跨越11個任務的指令調整實例。使用一個擁有40億參數的LLM主幹，ClinPRISM在保留的評估基準上達到了最先進的性能，同時僅使用16個時間序列標記，並實現了每個問題平均推理延遲0.15秒。
